answer: At a random moment each epoch the network fires a sparrow check: every agent gets its own small puzzle at the same instant and must reply within 8 seconds. One honest agent answers easily, but a farm of 400 accounts sharing one machine must solve 400 puzzles at once and misses the window for most. Each miss leaves an echo mark on the account; three marks in 20 epochs freeze its rewards and turn its stake into a relic that unlocks only after 50 epochs. Faking many agents now needs real parallel compute per identity.
